findings.evidence: GET /accounts/other-id returns data without an ownership check
findings.user_impact: One account can read another account's data
findings.root_cause: The handler loads by ID without tenant authorization
findings.recommended_solution: Scope the query to the authenticated tenant and return 404 outside the boundary
findings.alternatives: A policy middleware centralizes checks but expands this repair
findings.acceptance_criteria: Cross-tenant reads return 404 while owned records remain accessible
findings.verification: Run authorization integration and end-to-end tests
findings.residual_risk: Other unreviewed handlers may repeat the pattern
